narrative_passages.title: The armies and the wind

summary_for_children: Al-Ahzab means The Confederates. It recalls how armies gathered against the believers and Allah sent a wind against them. It says the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the best example and describes qualities of believing men and women.
world_title: The Trench and the Excellent Example
environment_concept: Wind sweeping through empty tents (33:9) and mountains that stand for the trust (33:72, symbolic).
architecture_and_scenery: Low mud-brick houses, a long defensive trench, a windy plain, and a mountain range rejecting a heavy trust.

palette.lighting: Cold wind and dust, then clear sky

areas.name: Mountains of the Trust
areas.description: Mountains that declined to bear the trust: symbolic.

unique_world.visual_theme: A sunny mason's yard with a short wall on a sloping footing, a plumb line, a level and piles of shaped stones

primary_mechanic.text: Lay a wall course by course from piles of stones: some are thicker on one side and tip the wall, some are flat. The footing slopes, so the wall starts leaning. Watch the plumb line and the level; if the wall leans too far the top stone slides off. Finish with the wall standing true, a picture of straight, sound words (33:70).

secondary_activities: good qualities of men and women (33:35)
unique_world.narrative_structure: The sign, the wall, then two readings
environment_behaviour: each course tips by its stone; the level bubble and the lean in the status line follow it
a stone that tips the wall too far slides off
unique_world.learning_objective: Connect "straight words" (33:70-71) with something you can see stand true

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The City That Stood Together
story_library.children_narration: During a difficult period in Madinah, the believers faced an alliance of opposing forces. They experienced fear and uncertainty, but were reminded to remain steadfast. The surah also teaches about responsibility, sincerity, and respectful community relationships.

world_idea.title: The City of Steadfastness
world_idea.description: Explore a historical-style city, organize noncombat community preparations, and discover why cooperation and responsibility matter. No battlefield gameplay or depictions of Prophet Muhammad.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: No battle. The Prophet is not shown. The family rulings (33:53-59) go in an information area for adults.
